name: Zillow Property Data
description: Get detailed property data from Zillow. Search by city, ZIP code, street address, Zillow Property ID, or URL. Returns 50+ fields per property including Zestimates, tax history, school ratings, and comparable sales. Supports property-type and price-range filters, a per-plan limit on properties per request (Basic 5, Pro 10, Ultra 25, Mega 50), CSV export via GET /v1/results/{job_id}?format=csv, and a GET /v1/usage endpoint for client-side budget tracking against your monthly quota.
